## Chat

### VS Code pet (Experimental)

A new highly experimental pet has been discovered in VS Code! Enter `/vscode-pet` in chat to meet your new companion.

From September 10 through September 17, 2026, [submit a name for the new VS Code pet](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/4iFTRDnvaY). Review the [contest terms and conditions](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agents/reference/chat-pet#_contest-terms-and-conditions).
